div.style: display: table-cell; vertical-align: middle; text-align: right;

span.t-att-style: 'background-color: %s; color: %s;' % ( '#276749' if doc.state == 'sent' else '#2b6cb0' if doc.state == 'approved' else '#b7791f' if doc.state == 'submitted' else '#4a5568' if doc.state == 'draft' else '#c53030', '#ffffff' )

div.t-attf-class: section-block #{'section-keep' if not doc.incident_ids or len(doc.incident_ids) <= 8 else ''}

t.div: No incidents reported during this period

div.t-attf-class: section-block #{'section-keep' if not doc.tour_log_ids or len(doc.tour_log_ids) <= 8 else ''}

t.div: No patrol tours logged during this period

div.t-attf-class: section-block #{'section-keep' if not doc.visitor_ids or len(doc.visitor_ids) <= 8 else ''}

t.div: No visitors logged during this period

div.t-attf-class: section-block #{'section-keep' if not doc.attendance_ids or len(doc.attendance_ids) <= 8 else ''}

t.div: No attendance records for this period

div.t-attf-class: section-block #{'section-keep' if not doc.task_ids or len(doc.task_ids) <= 8 else ''}
